name: Camera Space Normalization via Similarity Transform
definition: Computes a 4x4 similarity transform matrix T and a scalar scale to normalize camera poses (c2w) and optionally point clouds, aligning the world up axis to the camera's negative Y axis and centering the scene.
summary: Camera Space Normalization via Similarity Transform aligns camera poses to a canonical frame using explicit geometric alignment rather than PCA, ensuring consistent scene scales for stable neural rendering training.
